# EllipAn { #astroapers.EllipAn }

```python
EllipAn(
    positions,
    a_in,
    b_in,
    a_out,
    b_out,
    *,
    theta_in=0.0,
    theta_out=None,
    validate=True,
)
```

Elliptical annulus in pixel coordinates.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**positions**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [tuple or array-like]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Annulus center or centers as ``(x, y)`` pixel coordinates. Multiple centers are accepted as an ``(N, 2)`` array-like object. Coordinates are copied into owned, read-only `float64` storage. Editing the input does not move the aperture; construct a new aperture to change centers. The `positions` attribute cannot be reassigned. C-order, Fortran-order, and strided inputs are accepted. Input ``(x, y)`` gives scalar sums; ``[(x, y)]`` gives length-one vector sums.

<code>[**a_in**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Inner ellipse semiaxes in pixels.

<code>[**b_in**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Inner ellipse semiaxes in pixels.

<code>[**a_out**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Outer ellipse semiaxes in pixels. Each outer axis must be at least the corresponding inner axis, and at least one outer axis must be larger.

<code>[**b_out**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Outer ellipse semiaxes in pixels. Each outer axis must be at least the corresponding inner axis, and at least one outer axis must be larger.

<code>[**theta_in**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation}[, default =]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Inner and outer rotation angles in radians, measured counterclockwise from the positive x axis. If ``theta_out`` is `None`, it defaults to ``theta_in``.

<code>[**theta_out**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation}[, default =]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Inner and outer rotation angles in radians, measured counterclockwise from the positive x axis. If ``theta_out`` is `None`, it defaults to ``theta_in``.

<code>[**validate**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.parameter-annotation}[, default =]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   If `False`, skip input validation and assume finite, positive geometry, ordered axes, and finite positions with shape ``(2,)`` or ``(N, 2)``. Coordinates are still copied and converted to `float64`.
